groups.name: jobs
groups.description: Manage jobs in the authenticated account.

commands.name: list
commands.description: List jobs (paginated).
examples:
# All jobs (first page)
cavuno jobs list

# Published only
cavuno jobs list --status published --limit 100

# Published jobs at a single company
cavuno jobs list --status published --company-id k17abc...

commands.name: get
commands.description: Fetch a single job by ID (enriched with description, company, places).

commands.name: create
commands.description: Create a draft job.

options.description: URL slug; auto-derived from title if omitted
Company ID (must belong to your account)
yes|no|unknown — visa sponsorship for remote candidates
JSON array, e.g. '[{"type":"all","value":"all"}]' — timezone constraint (auto-derived from --remote-permits when omitted)
JSON array, e.g. '[{"city":"Berlin","country":"DE"}]' — required for on_site/hybrid
Allow equivalent experience to substitute for education
Mark as a featured job on the public board
Expiry as ISO 8601 datetime (defaults to 30 days from creation when omitted)

examples:
# Minimal
cavuno jobs create --title "Senior Backend Engineer"

# Common remote-only case
cavuno jobs create \
  --title "Senior Platform Engineer" \
  --description "We’re hiring..." \
  --employment-type full_time \
  --remote-option remote \
  --seniority senior \
  --company-id k18acme...

# Hybrid role (requires --office-locations)
cavuno jobs create \
  --title "Staff Engineer" \
  --remote-option hybrid \
  --in-office-period per_week \
  --in-office-frequency 2 \
  --office-locations '[{"city":"Berlin","country":"DE"}]'

# Capture the new ID
NEW_ID=$(cavuno jobs create --title "Test" | jq -r .id)

commands.name: update
commands.description: Update fields on an existing job.

options.description: Company ID (must belong to your account)
JSON array; pass `[]` to clear (PATCH never auto-re-derives)
JSON array; required when --remote-option is on_site/hybrid
Comma-separated canonical skill slugs; pass an empty value to clear
Comma-separated canonical category slugs; pass an empty value to clear
true|false (string accepted; PATCH semantics — explicit value required)
true|false (string accepted; PATCH semantics — explicit value required)
ISO 8601 datetime (parsed to epoch ms); pass `null` to clear

examples:
# Rename
cavuno jobs update k17abc... --title "Renamed role"

# Re-author the remote-permit set + sponsorship
cavuno jobs update k17abc... \
  --remote-permits '[{"type":"country","value":"US"}]' \
  --remote-sponsorship yes

# Clear an existing expiry
cavuno jobs update k17abc... --expires-at null

# Mark as featured
cavuno jobs update k17abc... --is-featured true
